## Round-2 per-clause verdicts (ba4afcc2)
Each line: item revN · clause · verdict · text oracle evidence.

- api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix rev2 · negative[2] · **FAIL** (rule-7 re-score; first runner scored pass). Lever: `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` with `timezone` on cube `showcase_delivery`, timeDimension `showcase_delivery.due_date` (a `Field.date`, `task.object.ts`), measure `showcase_delivery.count`; 10 seeded tasks, stored `due_date` 2026-10-01, 10-13, 10-21, 10-22, 10-29, 10-31, 11-03, 11-08, 11-13, 11-18 (read back via `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_task?$select=due_date`). Driver path (`timezone: "UTC"`) answers exactly the stored days and carries `data.sql` `SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', due_date) …`. In-memory path (`timezone: "America/New_York"`, no `sql`; `/analytics/sql` answers 501) labels the same rows 2026-09-30, 10-12, 10-20, 10-21, 10-28, 10-30, 11-02, 11-07, 11-12, 11-17 — every key one day early; month granularity {2026-09:1, 2026-10:5, 2026-11:4} vs driver {2026-10:6, 2026-11:4}; quarter {Q3:1, Q4:9} vs {Q4:10}. America/Los_Angeles identical; zero-offset (`Etc/UTC`, `Africa/Abidjan`) and positive-offset zones agree with the driver. Reproduced by two independent runners on fresh boots. Why FAIL: a `date` is a timezone-naive calendar day (ADR-0053: "never converted to an instant and never timezone-shifted"), so the same day value has one correct label in every zone; the two paths labelling the same value differently is the #3773 seam negative[2] names ("a FAIL even when each path is self-consistent"). The first runner's narrow reading ("same instant") only holds if a date is treated as an instant, which ADR-0053 forbids.

## Reproduction rules (fails)
- api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix · negative[2] — fresh stock showcase boot (`--seed-admin`), admin bearer from `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email`:
  1. `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` body `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":["showcase_delivery.count"],"timeDimensions":[{"dimension":"showcase_delivery.due_date","granularity":"day"}],"timezone":"UTC"}` → keys equal the stored `due_date` values (first key `2026-10-01`), response has `sql`.
  2. Same body with `"timezone":"America/New_York"` → expected the same keys; actual every key one day earlier (first key `2026-09-30`), no `sql`.
  3. Same with `"granularity":"month"` → expected `{2026-10: 6, 2026-11: 4}`; actual `{2026-09: 1, 2026-10: 5, 2026-11: 4}`.
  Mechanism: `bucketDateKey` (`packages/core/src/utils/datetime.ts:313-334`) does `new Date(String(value))` — '2026-10-01' becomes UTC midnight — then `calendarPartsInTzOrUtc(d, timezone)`; no date-vs-datetime branch. Callers `packages/objectql/src/in-memory-aggregation.ts` (`projectGroupValue` → `bucketDateValue`, passes `timezone` regardless of field type) and `service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` (`selection.timezone ?? contextTimezone ?? 'UTC'`). The parity gate `packages/verify/src/date-bucket-parity.ts` probes date columns at UTC only.
  Reach today: only callers that pass an explicit `timezone` — setting the org timezone (`PUT /api/settings/localization {"timezone":"America/New_York"}`) did not reach analytics in this build, and objectui at 4016370a sends no analytics `timezone`.

- api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix · knownGaps[1] / step 4 / negative[2]: the timezone lever is not on the door the item drives — `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_account/query` with a `timezone` key answers 400 INVALID_FIELD (`protocol.ts` does not forward it; `engine.aggregate` reads only `query.timezone`). The only wire lever is `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` with `timezone`, on stock cube `showcase_delivery` / `due_date` (not `showcase_account.signed_on`). Path is observable: `data.sql` present (driver) vs absent (in-memory), `/analytics/sql` 501 for non-UTC. Name the route, cube, dimension and a negative-offset zone in step 4; and make negative[2] say explicitly that for a `date` dimension the label must be zone-independent (for a `datetime` different zones legitimately label differently).
